repo_notes.content: Joomla extension package (pkg_j2xml, PHP 8.4/8.5) that exports/imports site content as XML and transfers it between Joomla instances via the Webservices REST API. Fork of eshiol/j2xml targeting Joomla 5 and 6 only — upstream supported 3.x/4.x.

Package parts: com_j2xml admin component (export/import/send UI + API), libraries/eshiol/J2xml core library (Exporter, Importer, Table/*, Version), system plugin, webservices plugin (REST import endpoint), cli/j2xml.php standalone importer.

Exporter.php turns Joomla rows (content, categories, users, menus, modules, contacts, weblinks, fields, tags, viewlevels, usernotes, images) into J2XML XML; Importer.php parses it and inserts/updates rows in the target instance. Per-entity Table wrappers live in Table/*.php.
libraries/eshiol/J2xmlpro/ and Pro manifests/language files are intentionally gitignored — this repo is open-source J2XML, not J2XML Pro. Do not commit Pro code.
VERSION file is the single source of truth for the release version; Composer is dev-only tooling (PHPUnit/PHPStan) — runtime deps stay vendored as Joomla libraries.
See AGENTS.md for repository layout, coding conventions, build/release flow, and manual testing expectations (Joomla 5/6, MySQL + PostgreSQL).
